ACCORDING to the powers conferred in (Chapter 267) second part (I) Sub-section of Entertainment Tax Ordinance, under-mentioned resolution determined by the Secretary of Matale Pradeshiya Sabha as the powers specified in Section II of theOrdinance on Entertainment Taxation is approved by the Minister in charge for Local Government, Central Provincial Councilas per the second Sub-section of above ordinance is hereby published based on its second sub section.
R. M. P. S. RATHNAYAKE,Secretary,Chief, Education and Local Government Ministry,Central Province.

On the powers conferred in section 9 (3) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, when it is held to conduct the entertainmentprograms in the Matale Pradeshiya Sabha Authority it has been determined to impose an entertainment tax of 15% of the feefor cinematic view and 20% of the fee for all other entertainment programs from the persons who organize the above as per theSection (2)1 of No. 12 of 1946 Tax Ordinance and Section 37 of the 1984 Tax Amendment Act.

ACCORDING to the powers conferred in (Chapter 267) second part (I) sub-section of Entertainment Tax Ordinance, under-mentioned resolution determined by the Secretary of Thalawakele Lindula Urban Council as the powers specified in Section IIof the Ordinance on Entertainment Taxation is approved by the Minister in charge for Local Government, Central ProvincialCouncil as per the second Sub-section of above ordinance is hereby published based on its second sub section.
R. M. P. S. RATHNAYAKE,Secretary,Chief, Education and Local Government Ministry,Central Province.

On the powers conferred to me in section 27 (3) of the Municipal Council Act, when it is held to conduct the entertainmentprograms in the Thalawakele Lindula Urban Council Authority it has been determined to impose an entertainment tax 15% ofthe fee for all entertainment programs from the persons who organize the above as per the Section (2)1 of No. 12 of 1946 TaxOrdinance and Section 37 of the 1984 Tax Amendment Act.
